---
description: Normalize a new request through the adaptive intake framework.
---

1. Use Intake Router.
2. Ask shared questions first.
3. Route to business, IT, or technical intake.
4. Produce `schemas/normalized-intake.schema.json`.
5. Search for duplicate/existing work where tools allow.
6. Suggest roadmap classification; do not invent it.
7. Draft acceptance criteria.
8. Stop at the human triage gate.
